channel.title: ViralGadgets: Blog
channel.description: Plain-English posts on the gadgets everyone is talking about: new launches, viral TikTok finds, deal timing, gift ideas and how to spot fake reviews.

item.title: Apple’s fall launches explained: iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, AirPods 5 and more
item.description: Everything Apple launched this fall in plain English: the foldable iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, and AirPods 5, with key dates.

item.title: Kodak Charmera: why a tiny keychain camera keeps selling out
item.description: Why the tiny Kodak Charmera keychain camera keeps selling out: blind boxes, retro filters and Gen Z nostalgia, plus what it can and can’t do before you buy one.

item.title: The digicam comeback: why old digital cameras are cool again

item.title: Black Friday tech deals: dates, timing and how to shop smart
item.description: Black Friday falls on 27 November 2026 and Cyber Monday on 30 November. How to plan, which gadgets usually drop most, and how to check a deal is real.

item.title: How to spot fake reviews and paid influencer posts
item.description: Spot fake gadget reviews and undisclosed influencer ads: the warning signs, the US, UK and EU rules, and what to do if a product or review seems fake.

item.title: TikTok made me buy it: which viral gadgets are actually worth it?

item.title: Christmas tech gift ideas by age
item.description: Christmas tech gift ideas for every age: screen-free kids’ gadgets, what teens want, picks for adults and easy tech for grandparents, plus timing tips.

item.title: Power banks on planes: the rules you need to know
item.description: Can you take a power bank on a plane? Hand-luggage-only rules, watt-hour limits, working out Wh from mAh, and airline rules on using them on board.

item.title: Smart glasses explained: Ray-Ban Meta and beyond
item.description: What smart glasses do in plain English: cameras, open-ear audio, AI assistants and in-lens displays, plus privacy etiquette and UK and EU availability.
